title: Let's Share Rebrand
description: Let's Share is a premium food brand in Muscat that creates sharing boxes for all kinds of gatherings. The goal of this rebrand was to improve the brand without changing what made it special. I kept the original idea and plated it out cohesively back tying the food with the gestures.
client: Let's Share founder, Marwa, reached out to me with hopes of taking her brand to the next level. Her cloud kitchen had already turned into a restaurant and now she was ready to invest in enhancing her overall brand outlook.

title: Wasta Branding
description: The project covered brand strategy, visual identity and packaging design, bringing Sarah’s vision to life through a playful, recognisable identity. A custom bilingual logo, warm earthy colours and geometric Omani motifs formed the visual foundation, while detailed packaging illustrations gave each blend its own character within a cohesive product family.
client: Sarah, co-founder of Wasta, approached HummingBird with the name “Wasta” already in mind and a vision for an Omani coffee alternative made from roasted date seeds. She wanted a brand that reflected its Arabian roots, commitment to sustainability and the sense of connection behind the name.

title: Misto Packaging
description: A playful packaging collection built around bold red and yellow colours, checkerboard accents, food illustrations and an expressive chef mascot. The design adapts across pizza boxes, food containers, sleeves and coffee cups, giving each format its own personality while keeping the range unmistakably Misto.
client: Misto is an Italian restaurant at Oman Avenues Mall, serving pizza, pasta, coffee and a range of takeaway favourites. The packaging project focused on expressing the restaurant’s friendly character through a consistent, recognisable look across its menu.

title: Burger Garage Ads
description: Burger Garage is an established burger chain in Oman, known for its bold personality and indulgent comfort food.
client: The “Cravings Made Easy” campaign put Burger Garage’s signature burgers and value meal offer at the centre of the design. Rich red backgrounds, bold yellow typography and appetising food photography created a vibrant visual across printed flyers and storefront advertising, making the offer easy to spot and hard to resist.

title: GSTL Company Profile
description: A company profile brochure designed to present GSTL’s expertise, product range, manufacturing partners and key projects. Clean layouts, industrial imagery and a green and white palette bring technical information together in a clear, professional format that reflects the company’s focus on quality and reliability.
client: Gulf Sealing Technologies LLC (GSTL), a subsidiary of Seeh Al Sarya Engineering, supplies valves, piping and engineered solutions to Oman’s oil, gas and petrochemical sectors.
